column1: # Lalivero main map: Sheba's absence, the aftermath of Venus Lighthouse, and the wharf.

column3: {text_effect:4}No...{reset_text_style} They took {actor_name:7}\nand fled toward the ruins.\nFaran went after them.{end_wait}
Our hope rests on\n{actor_name:7}. If she is lost,\nwhat becomes of Lalivero?{end_wait}
This began when Tolbi\ntook {actor_name:7} from us.\nWe should have resisted.{end_wait}
Faran followed {actor_name:7}.\nHe will not abandon her.\nHe must bring her home.{end_wait}
That rumble from the\nruins sounded like a\nwarning.{end_wait}
The ground shook near\nthe ruins before all this.{page_break}I pray {actor_name:7} and the\nothers are still alive.{end_wait}
If I were stronger, I\nwould have stood between\nthem and {actor_name:7}!{end_wait}
Maybe {actor_name:7} can use her\npowers to escape. She\nhas surprised us before.{end_wait}
Babi's most guarded\npossession is kept here.{page_break}No one is permitted\ninside.{end_wait}

Iodem does not seem
troubled by the fall of
Babi Lighthouse.{page_break}Perhaps he has never
believed in Babi's cause.
Perhaps he knows more.{end_wait}
Keep out. The passage\nbeyond this point is\nnot safe.{end_wait}
Are you leaving\nLalivero?{end_now}
I was told to admit you\nif you came here.{page_break}The way is open. Go on.{end_wait}
More of Tolbi's soldiers\nhave fallen. How many\nmust suffer before it ends?{end_wait}
Where are you going,\n{actor_name:1}? Iodem asked us\nto wait. Did you forget?{end_now}
Babi spoke of an ancient\nship, a vessel unlike\nanything built today.{end_wait}
I thought the ship at\nIdejima belonged to Babi.\nWas I mistaken?{end_wait}

Where are you going?
Aren't we taking Babi's
ship?{page_break}We should visit the wharf
and speak with the guard
who keeps it closed.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Ugh...{reset_text_style} They caught us\nbefore we could react.{page_break}But why did they take\n{actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
They were stronger than\nwe expected. We could\nnot hold them back.{end_wait}

If {actor_name:7} had not been
there, perhaps we could
have fought them off.{page_break}But even then, we were
outmatched.{end_wait}
They turned fire on us.\nThere was no way to keep\nthe line together.{end_wait}
We failed to stop them.\nWe failed {actor_name:7}...{end_wait}

What will they do with
{actor_name:7} in the ruins?{page_break}No. I cannot bear to
imagine what they might
intend.{end_wait}
We should never have let\nTolbi take {actor_name:7} away.\nWe should have fought.{end_wait}
Faran has not returned.\nWhat has he found inside\nthose ruins?{end_wait}
The stones we set for\nthe lighthouse... Will\nthey hold after all this?{end_wait}
I tried to stand between\nthe attackers and her.{page_break}My hands shook. I could\nnot move when it mattered.{end_wait}
They will answer for this.{page_break}They will learn why\nLalivero holds {actor_name:7}\nso dear.{end_wait}

I guard a secret I do
not understand myself.{page_break}What could Babi value
so much that no one may
see it?{end_wait}
I thought I would not\nrecover, but the wounds\nhave finally closed.{end_wait}

I will not lower my guard
again.{page_break}We must be ready to
protect Lalivero when
danger returns.{end_wait}
Where is {actor_name:7} now?\nI cannot stop worrying\nabout her.{end_wait}

I saw Venus Lighthouse
ignite in the distance.{page_break}For one moment, the whole
sky seemed to hold its
breath.{end_wait}

The blast in the Venus
Ruins brought Babi's
lighthouse down.{page_break}No human work could
stand against power
like that.{end_wait}

The land behind Venus
Lighthouse is under water.{page_break}The old powers have
changed the coast in
an instant.{end_wait}

You escaped Venus
Lighthouse? I can hardly
believe it.{page_break}The tunnel beneath it
must have brought you
back safely.{end_wait}
If you defeated those\npeople, you must be\nstronger than you look.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} leapt from the\nlighthouse into the sea?{page_break}How could anyone survive\nsuch a fall?{end_wait}
A ship has been hidden\nat this wharf all along.{page_break}It must be unlike any\nvessel we have seen.{end_wait}

My wounds have healed,
but my confidence has
not returned.{page_break}I will not fight again.
I have had enough.{end_wait}
I wanted to stand with\nthe others at Venus\nLighthouse.{end_wait}

If {actor_name:7} used her power{pause_20_skippable},
she may still be alive.{page_break}But the sea is merciless.
I fear what she faced
out there.{end_wait}
After all that has\nhappened, Lalivero no\nlonger feels safe.{end_wait}

Venus Lighthouse has
watched over Lalivero
for generations.{page_break}Its light may yet mark
a better beginning for
this town.{end_wait}

The sea has grown rough
since the peninsula fell.{page_break}One disaster seems to
call another. How much
more can this coast bear?{end_wait}
Venus Lighthouse still\nstands after everything.{page_break}Perhaps its builders knew\nmore than we ever did.{end_wait}
You must be formidable\nto have survived that.{page_break}Would you take me on\nas an apprentice?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} will survive{em_dash}\nshe has endured worse\nthan a fall.{end_wait}
A strange place to moor\nBabi's private vessel.\nWhat was he hiding?{end_wait}
